answers.q1: The room advances show time and bodies with the raw non-negative _process delta (master: Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:293,301,317), not a smoothed delta. _pump_to then runs once per engine beat until the horizon (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:323-324): at the configured 20 Hz state rate, a 100 ms advance is about two ticks plus horizon work, with no iteration bound.
answers.q2: No named AnimationPlayer, body, or camera path advances in _physics_process or a physics callback. setup hands the AnimationPlayers to the caller's manual clock (Godot/scripts/FightStagePlayer.gd:1076-1079); the room calls advance from _process with raw delta (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:293,314-317), and advance calls _ap.advance then grounding (Godot/scripts/FightStagePlayer.gd:1093-1103).
answers.q3: project.godot writes rendering_method="forward_plus". The other required keys are absent: vsync_mode default (Godot 4 default enabled), max_fps default (0/unlimited), physics_ticks_per_second default (60), physics_interpolation default (false), and low_processor_mode default (false).
answers.q4: setup's loads/build/mount/bind and initial idle occur before the fight state starts (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:192-207,226-259). During the bout, event presentation calls present_live (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:344-350), and a new role can call AnimationPlayer.play (Godot/scripts/FightStagePlayer.gd:315), so first clip/resource/shader use remains a hitch candidate. The branch-only watcher instantiates the room before its walk-in (Godot/tools/watch_live_room.gd:49-58); no post-start load is evidenced by the named windows.
answers.q5: Per room frame, _process performs gap motion, a catch-up loop, schedule/presentation checks, settle, and two Array-literal player loops (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:293-317,455-462). Impact presentation allocates/joins strings and sets Labels on events (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:344-390,516-557), not every frame. The branch watcher adds per-frame stopwatch/readout text and get() lookups (Godot/tools/watch_live_room.gd:74-94,98-116), then scans seven bones per fighter for camera framing (Godot/tools/watch_live_room.gd:161-179).
answers.q6: Yes for every item: fixed 1/30 Movie Maker delta waits for each frame, so catch-up, animation advancement, allocations, Label/layout work, and first-use compilation lengthen render time instead of producing a missed/uneven live frame. No for equivalence: it does not remove the work or prove live frame pacing, and branch-only watcher work is included only when that tool is run. The unbounded pump is especially important: a late live frame can do all pending ticks in one callback (Godot/scripts/FightWorldLiveScreen.gd:323-324).
